create_subtitle: Add multiple products, IMEIs and barcodes within one supplier invoice.
same_price_confirm:
Product "{name}" is already added with the same purchase price.

Do you want to increase its quantity by +{quantity}?

Press Cancel to add a separate row.
price_row_help: The same product at a different price is added as a separate row. At the same price you are asked to confirm a quantity increase.
manual_add_disabled_title: Manual product add is not available here.
manual_add_disabled_body: Add items to a supplier purchase by scanning the Barcode/SKU of an existing product/variant. If the product is not found, an authorized user must first create the product/variant from the Product/Catalog module.
device_price_help: For IMEI-tracked products, each device's purchase price can be edited separately.
price_visibility_note: Only Super Admin, Admin and Accountant can see the purchase price and payment amount.
list_subtitle: Supplier purchase invoices, products, IMEI and barcode history.
list_price_visibility_note: Only Super Admin, Admin and Accountant can see purchase price and payment information.
